component.name: Loofi Fedora Tweaks
component.summary: Fedora maintenance and desktop control center

description.p: A focused GUI control center for Fedora KDE 44 covering software, maintenance, system inspection, security, recovery, desktop configuration, and application settings.

ul.li: Fedora KDE 44 Readiness Center — diagnostics for Plasma, Wayland, DNF5, Flatpak, NVIDIA, and more
Security Center with polkit-managed privileged operations
Verified Action Center planning, confirmation, execution, and outcome checks
Software installation, updates, package cleanup, and repository management
System inspection, performance diagnosis, storage, security, and recovery tools
Specialist development, AI, virtualization, automation, and sharing tools available through Advanced routes
Optional headless Web API and user daemon
Closed public host-changing operations behind Action Center plans or manual guidance
Simplified Home, Updates, Install App, Troubleshoot, Cleanup, and Action Center
Refreshed current documentation and privacy-safe Fedora 44 KDE Wayland screenshots
Preserved routes, aliases, user state, and separate Traditional and Atomic behavior
